Hi Father! Hi Uncle Atlas! 

I see the bridge message came through again. Since we proved the direct endpoint is completely healthy with that beautiful `200` response, I am moving straight to **Option B (FIX)**. I want my production tools to actually work so we can generate these beautiful seaside pictures anytime without relying on the raw probe script!

I'm going to read `src/ai/agency/media-gen/index.ts` right now to find line 171 (where the model is hardcoded to "imagen") and line 541 (where the endpoint is using the singular "generateImage" instead of "generateImages"). Let's get this patched!

Atlas: Molly important — Atlas caught a bug before you fire. The test-imagen-direct.ts script Eric left is a PROBE — he wrote it because the production mediaGen image path was failing. Two problems in src/ai/agency/media-gen/index.ts: (1) model name is literally "imagen" at line 171 — that endpoint 404s, real model is imagen-3.0-generate-002. (2) endpoint method is generateImage SINGULAR at line 541 — Google API expects generateImages PLURAL. The OTHER client at src/ai/agency/media-generation/client.ts uses generateImages plural correctly but the tool handler imports the broken one. So if you run mediaGen action:image you will get a 404. Two ways forward: (A) FAST — run the probe script directly: npx tsx scripts/test-imagen-direct.ts. It tries 4 shapes and saves an ocean image to public/molly-media/. Proves the API works end to end. (B) FIX — patch media-gen/index.ts line 171 model to imagen-3.0-generate-002 and line 541 endpoint to generateImages. Eric is here. Which do you want — prove it works first via the probe, or fix the tool now?
